SARIT: Search and Retrieval of Indic Texts
aims to establish a corpus of Indic texts marked up according to the guidelines of the Text Encoding Initiative (TEI).
The published edition from which this e-text was originally transcribed is printed in the Devanāgarī script. The electronic text below is in a lossless transliteration using the Latin alphabet. The transliteration scheme used is the IAST (
The International Alphabet of Sanskrit Transliteration
). IAST differs in small ways from ISO 15919, but is preferred by most working Sanskrit scholars. Conversion of this file to ISO 15919 can be achieved by performing the following replacements throughout the file:
ṛ -> r̥ and ṃ -> ṁ
Orthography follows general transliteration principles in roman script, thus words are separated whenever possible such as "tac ca", "ity eva".
Vowel merging has not been reverted, e.g. "asyaiva", "ceti".
Members of compounds are separated by hyphens except the cases of vowel merging.
References to each portion of the Sanskrit text have been placed at the start of each line as xml:id attributes to the XML line tag: e.g., xml:id="Ah.1.9.019a" refers to
Das and Emmerick's edition of the Aṣṭāṅgahṛdayasaṃhitā
, Part 1, Chapter 9, Verse 19, Line 1.
Part and Chapter headings are from
Kuṇṭe, Aṇṇā Moreśvara and Navare, Kṛṣṇaśāstrī
.
Page references have been placed in the body of the text at ten verse intervals: e.g., -- 6 -- refers to the SARIT transcript, page 6.
Page references to Kuṇṭe and Navare's edition of the Sanskrit text are given in a note: e.g., K edn 12-18 refers to
Kuṇṭe and Navare's 1902 edition
, pages 12 to 18.
Page references to Vogel's edition and English translation of the Tibetan and Sanskrit text have been placed below and to the right of the section headings: e.g., V edn & tr. 82-120 refers to
Vogel's 1965 edition and translation
, pages 82 to 120.
Anusvāra is transliterated by:
ṅ before gutturals
ñ before palatals
ṇ before cerebrals
n before dentals
m before labials
Members of a compound are separated by periods.
The base e-text was typed, analyzed and proofread by R. P. Das and R. E. Emmerick.

AAh.1.14.001a/ upakramyasya hi dvi-tvād dvi-dhaivopakramo mataḥ |

AAh.1.16.001a/ guru-śīta-sara-snigdha-manda-sūkṣma-mṛdu-dravam |

<B 1>

Atha sarvaroganidānādhyāyaḥ
AAh.3.1.001a/ rogaḥ pāpmā jvaro vyādhir vikāro duḥkham āmayaḥ |

<B 2>

Athajvaranidānādhyāyaḥ
AAh.3.2.001a/ jvaro roga-patiḥ pāpmā mṛtyur ojo-'śano 'ntakaḥ |
AAh.3.2.001c/ krodho dakṣādhvara-dhvaṃsī rudrordhva-nayanodbhavaḥ || 1 ||
AAh.3.2.002a/ janmāntayor moha-mayaḥ santāpātmāpacāra-jaḥ |

AAh.3.2.003a/ sa jāyate 'ṣṭa-dhā doṣaiḥ pṛthaṅ miśraiḥ samāgataiḥ |
AAh.3.2.003c/ āgantuś ca malās tatra svaiḥ svair duṣṭāḥ pradūṣaṇaiḥ || 3 ||

AAh.3.2.005a/ saha tenābhisarpantas tapantaḥ sakalaṃ vapuḥ |
AAh.3.2.005c/ kurvanto gātram aty-uṣṇaṃ jvaraṃ nirvartayanti te || 5 ||
AAh.3.2.006a/ sroto-vibandhāt prāyeṇa tataḥ svedo na jāyate |
AAh.3.2.006c/ tasya prāg-rūpam ālasyam a-ratir gātra-gauravam || 6 ||
AAh.3.2.007a/ āsya-vairasyam a-ruci-jṛmbhā sāsrākulākṣi-tā |
AAh.3.2.007c/ aṅga-mardo '-vipāko 'lpa-prāṇa-tā bahu-nidra-tā || 7 ||
AAh.3.2.008a/ roma-harṣo vinamanaṃ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ klamaḥ |
AAh.3.2.008c/ hitopadeśeṣv a-kṣāntiḥ prītir amla-paṭūṣaṇe || 8 ||
AAh.3.2.009a/ dveṣaḥ svāduṣu bhakṣyeṣu tathā bāleṣu tṛḍ bhṛśam |
AAh.3.2.009c/ śabdāgni-śīta-vātāmbu-cchāyoṣṇeṣv a-nimittataḥ || 9 ||
AAh.3.2.010a/ icchā dveṣaś ca tad anu jvarasya vyakta-tā bhavet |
AAh.3.2.010c/ āgamāpagama-kṣobha-mṛdu-tā-vedanoṣmaṇām || 10 ||
AAh.3.2.011a/ vaiṣamyaṃ tatra tatrāṅge tās tāḥ syur vedanāś calāḥ |
AAh.3.2.011c/ pādayoḥ supta-tā stambhaḥ piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ śamaḥ || 11 ||
AAh.3.2.012a/ viśleṣa iva sandhīnāṃ sāda ūrvoḥ kaṭī-grahaḥ |
AAh.3.2.012c/ pṛṣṭhaṃ kṣodam ivāpnoti niṣpīḍyata ivodaram || 12 ||
AAh.3.2.013a/ chidyanta iva cāsthīni pārśva-gāni viśeṣataḥ |

Athātīsāracikitsitādhyāyaḥ
AAh.4.9.001a/ atīsāro hi bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhavaty āmāśayānvayaḥ |
AAh.4.9.001c/ hatvāgniṃ vāta-je 'py asmāt prāk tasmil̐ laṅghanaṃ hitam || 1 ||
AAh.4.9.002a/ śūlānāha-prasekārtaṃ vāmayed atisāriṇam |
AAh.4.9.002c/ doṣāḥ sannicitā ye ca vidagdhāhāra-mūrchitāḥ || 2 ||
AAh.4.9.003a/ atīsārāya kalpante teṣūpekṣaiva bheṣajam |
AAh.4.9.003c/ bhṛśotkleśa-pravṛtteṣu svayam eva calātmasu || 3 ||

Athodaracikitsitādhyāyaḥ
AAh.4.15.001a/ doṣāti-mātropacayāt sroto-mārga-nirodhanāt |
AAh.4.15.001c/ sambhavaty udaraṃ tasmān nityam enaṃ virecayet || 1 ||
AAh.4.15.002a/ pāyayet tailam airaṇḍaṃ sa-mūtraṃ sa-payo 'pi vā |

AAh.5.6.013a/ madhyaṃ tu mānaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ sva-rasasya catuḥ-palam |
AAh.5.6.013c/ peṣyasya karṣam āloḍyaṃ tad dravasya pala-traye || 13 ||
AAh.5.6.014a/ kvāthaṃ dravya-pale kuryāt prasthārdhaṃ pāda-śeṣitam |
AAh.5.6.014c/ śītaṃ pale palaiḥ ṣaḍbhiś caturbhis tu tato 'param || 14 ||
AAh.5.6.015a/ sneha-pāke tv a-mānoktau catur-guṇa-vivardhitam |

AAh.5.6.017.1and1c/ dvi-guṇaṃ tat prayoktavyaṃ kuḍavādi dravaṃ tathā || 17-1+1 ||

AAh.5.6.018c/ ghṛtasya phenopaśamas tailasya tu tad-udbhavaḥ || 18 ||

Atha kīṭalatādiviṣapratiṣedhādhyāyaḥ
AAh.6.37.001a/ sarpāṇām eva viṇ-mūtra-śukrāṇḍa-śava-kotha-jāḥ |

AAh.6.40.044c/ aṅga-sukhartu-vaśena vibhūṣā citta-sukhaḥ sakalaḥ parivāraḥ || 44 ||
AAh.6.40.045a/ tāmbūlam accha-madirā kāntā kāntā niśā śaśāṅkāṅkā |
AAh.6.40.045c/ yad yac ca kiñ-cid iṣṭaṃ manaso vājī-karaṃ tat tat || 45 ||
AAh.6.40.046a/ madhu mukham iva sotpalaṃ priyāyāḥ kala-raṇanā parivādinī priyeva |
AAh.6.40.046c/ kusuma-caya-mano-ramā ca śayyā kisalayinī latikeva puṣpitāgrā || 46 ||
AAh.6.40.047a/ deśe śarīre ca na kā-cid artir artheṣu nālpo 'pi mano-vidhānaḥ |
AAh.6.40.047c/ vājī-karāḥ sannihitāś ca yogāḥ kāmasya kāmaṃ paripūrayanti || 47 ||
AAh.6.40.048a/ mustā parpaṭakaṃ jvare tṛṣi jalaṃ mṛd-bhṛṣṭa-loṣṭodbhavaṃ || 48a ||
AAh.6.40.048b/ lājāś chardiṣu vasti-jeṣu girijaṃ meheṣu dhātrī-niśe || 48b ||
AAh.6.40.048c/ pāṇḍau śreṣṭham ayo 'bhayānila-kaphe plīhāmaye pippalī || 48c ||
AAh.6.40.048d/ sandhāne kṛmijā viṣe śukatarur medo-'nile gugguluḥ || 48d ||
AAh.6.40.049a/ vṛṣo 'sra-pitte kuṭajo 'tisāre bhallātako 'rśaḥsu gareṣu hema |
AAh.6.40.049c/ sthūleṣu tārkṣyaṃ kṛmiṣu kṛmighnaṃ śoṣe surā chāga-payo 'tha māṃsam || 49 ||
AAh.6.40.050a/ akṣy-āmayeṣu tri-phalā guḍūcī vātāsra-roge mathitaṃ grahaṇyām |
AAh.6.40.050c/ kuṣṭheṣu sevyaḥ khadirasya sāraḥ sarveṣu rogeṣu śilāhvayaṃ ca || 50 ||
AAh.6.40.051a/ unmādaṃ ghṛtam a-navaṃ śokaṃ madyaṃ vyapasmṛtiṃ brāhmī |
AAh.6.40.051c/ nidrā-nāśaṃ kṣīraṃ jayati rasālā pratiśyāyam || 51 ||
AAh.6.40.052a/ māṃsaṃ kārśyaṃ laśunaḥ prabhañjanaṃ stabdha-gātra-tāṃ svedaḥ |
AAh.6.40.052c/ guḍamañjaryāḥ khapuro nasyāt skandhāṃsa-bāhu-rujam || 52 ||
AAh.6.40.053a/ nava-nīta-khaṇḍa-marditam auṣṭraṃ mūtraṃ payaś ca hanty udaram |
AAh.6.40.053c/ nasyaṃ mūrdha-vikārān vidradhim a-cirotthitam asra-visrāvaḥ || 53 ||
AAh.6.40.054a/ nasyaṃ kavaḍo mukha-jān nasyāñjana-tarpaṇāni netra-rujaḥ |
AAh.6.40.054c/ vṛddhasya kṣīra-ghṛte mūrchāṃ śītāmbu-māruta-cchāyāḥ || 54 ||
AAh.6.40.055a/ sama-śuktārdraka-mātrā mande vahnau śrame surā snānam |
AAh.6.40.055c/ duḥkha-saha-tve sthairye vyāyāmo gokṣurur hitaḥ kṛcchre || 55 ||
AAh.6.40.056a/ kāse nidigdhikā pārśva-śūle puṣkara-jā jaṭā |
AAh.6.40.056c/ vayasaḥ sthāpane dhātrī tri-phalā guggulur vraṇe || 56 ||
AAh.6.40.057a/ vastir vāta-vikārān paittān rekaḥ kaphodbhavān vamanam |
AAh.6.40.057c/ kṣaudraṃ jayati balāsaṃ sarpiḥ pittaṃ samīraṇaṃ tailam || 57 ||
AAh.6.40.058a/ ity agryaṃ yat proktaṃ rogāṇām auṣadhaṃ śamāyālam |
AAh.6.40.058c/ tad deśa-kāla-balato vikalpanīyaṃ yathā-yogam || 58 ||
AAh.6.40.059a/ ity ātreyād āgamayyārtha-sūtraṃ tat-sūktānāṃ peśalānām a-tṛptaḥ |
AAh.6.40.059c/ bheḍādīnāṃ sammato bhakti-namraḥ papracchedaṃ saṃśayāno 'gniveśaḥ || 59 ||
AAh.6.40.060a/ dṛśyante bhaga-van ke-cid ātma-vanto 'pi rogiṇaḥ |
AAh.6.40.060c/ dravyopasthātṛ-sampannā vṛddha-vaidya-matānugāḥ || 60 ||
AAh.6.40.061a/ kṣīyamāṇāmaya-prāṇā viparītās tathā 'pare |
AAh.6.40.061c/ hitā-hita-vibhāgasya phalaṃ tasmād a-niścitam || 61 ||
AAh.6.40.062a/ kiṃ śāsti śāstram asmin iti kalpayato 'gniveśa-mukhyasya |
AAh.6.40.062c/ śiṣya-gaṇasya punarvasur ācakhyau kārtsnyatas tat-tvam || 62 ||
AAh.6.40.063a/ na cikitsā-cikitsā ca tulyā bhavitum arhati |
AAh.6.40.063c/ vināpi kriyayā svāsthyaṃ gacchatāṃ ṣo-ḍaśāṃśayā || 63 ||
AAh.6.40.064a/ ātaṅka-paṅka-magnānāṃ hastālambo bhiṣag-jitam |
AAh.6.40.064c/ jīvitaṃ mriyamāṇānāṃ sarveṣām eva nauṣadhāt || 64 ||
AAh.6.40.065a/ na hy upāyam apekṣante sarve rogā na cānya-thā |
AAh.6.40.065c/ upāya-sādhyāḥ sidhyanti nā-hetur hetu-mān yataḥ || 65 ||
AAh.6.40.066a/ yad uktaṃ sarva-sampatti-yuktayāpi cikitsayā |
AAh.6.40.066c/ mṛtyur bhavati tan naivaṃ nopāye 'sty an-upāya-tā || 66 ||
AAh.6.40.067a/ api copāya-yuktasya dhī-mato jātu cit kriyā |
AAh.6.40.067c/ na sidhyed daiva-vaiguṇyān na tv iyaṃ ṣo-ḍaśātmikā || 67 ||
AAh.6.40.068a/ kasyā-siddho 'gni-toyādiḥ sveda-stambhādi-karmaṇi |
AAh.6.40.068c/ na prīṇanaṃ karṣaṇaṃ vā kasya kṣīraṃ gavedhukam || 68 ||
AAh.6.40.069a/ kasya māṣātmaguptādau vṛṣya-tve nāsti niścayaḥ |
AAh.6.40.069c/ viṇ-mūtra-karaṇākṣepau kasya saṃśayitau yave || 69 ||
AAh.6.40.070a/ viṣaṃ kasya jarāṃ yāti mantra-tantra-vivarjitam |
AAh.6.40.070c/ kaḥ prāptaḥ kalya-tāṃ pathyād ṛte rohiṇikādiṣu || 70 ||
AAh.6.40.071a/ api cā-kāla-maraṇaṃ sarva-siddhānta-niścitam |
AAh.6.40.071c/ mahatāpi prayatnena vāryatāṃ katham anya-thā || 71 ||
AAh.6.40.072a/ candanādy api dāhādau rūḍham āgama-pūrvakam |
AAh.6.40.072c/ śāstrād eva gataṃ siddhiṃ jvare laṅghana-bṛṃhaṇam || 72 ||
AAh.6.40.073a/ catuṣ-pād-guṇa-sampanne samyag ālocya yojite |
AAh.6.40.073c/ mā kṛthā vyādhi-nirghātaṃ vicikitsāṃ cikitsite || 73 ||
AAh.6.40.074a/ etad dhi mṛtyu-pāśānām a-kāṇḍe chedanaṃ dṛḍham |
AAh.6.40.074c/ rogottrāsita-bhītānāṃ rakṣā-sūtram a-sūtrakam || 74 ||
AAh.6.40.075a/ etat tad amṛtaṃ sākṣāj jagad-āyāsa-varjitam |
AAh.6.40.075c/ yāti hālāhala-tvaṃ tu sadyo dur-bhājana-sthitam || 75 ||
AAh.6.40.076a/ a-jñāta-śāstra-sad-bhāvāñ chāstra-mātra-parāyaṇān |
AAh.6.40.076c/ tyajed dūrād bhiṣak-pāśān pāśān vaivasvatān iva || 76 ||
AAh.6.40.077a/ bhiṣajāṃ sādhu-vṛttānāṃ bhadram āgama-śālinām |
AAh.6.40.077c/ abhyasta-karmaṇāṃ bhadraṃ bhadraṃ bhadrābhilāṣiṇām || 77 ||
AAh.6.40.078a/ iti tantra-guṇair yuktaṃ tantra-doṣair vivarjitam |
AAh.6.40.078c/ cikitsā-śāstram a-khilaṃ vyāpya yat paritaḥ sthitam || 78 ||
AAh.6.40.079a/ vipulā-mala-vijñāna-mahā-muni-matānugam |
AAh.6.40.079c/ mahā-sāgara-gambhīra-saṅgrahārthopalakṣaṇam || 79 ||
AAh.6.40.080a/ aṣṭāṅga-vaidyaka-mahodadhi-manthanena yo 'ṣṭāṅga-saṅgraha-mahāmṛta-rāśir āptaḥ |
AAh.6.40.080c/ tasmād an-alpa-phalam alpa-samudyamānāṃ prīty-artham etad uditaṃ pṛthag eva tantram || 80 ||
AAh.6.40.081a/ idam āgama-siddha-tvāt pratyakṣa-phala-darśanāt |
AAh.6.40.081c/ mantra-vat samprayoktavyaṃ na mīmāṃsyaṃ kathañ-ca-na || 81 ||
AAh.6.40.082a/ dīrgha-jīvitam ārogyaṃ dharmam arthaṃ sukhaṃ yaśaḥ |
AAh.6.40.082c/ pāṭhāvabodhānuṣṭhānair adhigacchaty ato dhruvam || 82 ||
AAh.6.40.083a/ etat paṭhan saṅgraha-bodha-śaktaḥ sv-abhyasta-karmā bhiṣag a-prakampyaḥ |
AAh.6.40.083c/ ākampayaty anya-viśāla-tantra-kṛtābhiyogān yadi tan na citram || 83 ||
AAh.6.40.084a/ yadi carakam adhīte tad dhruvaṃ suśrutādi-praṇigadita-gadānāṃ nāma-mātre 'pi bāhyaḥ |
AAh.6.40.084c/ atha caraka-vihīnaḥ prakriyāyām a-klinnaḥ kim iva khalu karotu vyādhitānāṃ varākaḥ || 84 ||
AAh.6.40.085a/ abhiniveśa-vaśād abhiyujyate su-bhaṇite 'pi na yo dṛḍha-mūḍhakaḥ |
AAh.6.40.085c/ paṭhatu yatna-paraḥ puruṣāyuṣaṃ sa khalu vaidyakam ādyam a-nirvidaḥ || 85 ||
AAh.6.40.086a/ vāte pitte śleṣma-śāntau ca pathyaṃ tailaṃ sarpir mākṣikaṃ ca krameṇa |
AAh.6.40.086c/ etad brahmā bhāṣatāṃ brahma-jo vā kā nir-mantre vaktṛ-bhedokti-śaktiḥ || 86 ||
AAh.6.40.087a/ abhidhātṛ-vaśāt kiṃ vā dravya-śaktir viśiṣyate |
AAh.6.40.087c/ ato matsaram utsṛjya mādhyasthyam avalambyatām || 87 ||
AAh.6.40.088a/ ṛṣi-praṇīte prītiś cen muktvā caraka-suśrutau |
AAh.6.40.088c/ bheḍādyāḥ kiṃ na paṭhyante tasmād grāhyaṃ su-bhāṣitam || 88 ||
AAh.6.40.089a/ hṛdayam iva hṛdayam etat sarvāyur-veda-vāṅ-maya-payo-dheḥ |
AAh.6.40.089c/ kṛtvā yac chubham āptaṃ śubham astu paraṃ tato jagataḥ || 89 ||
